reason: README Quick Start runs Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B text generation, a small model feasible on CPU with no gated access.
demo: README_en.md Quick Start: Text generation with large language model
goal: Install PaddleNLP (CPU paddlepaddle) so that the README quick-start works: load AutoTokenizer and AutoModelForCausalLM for Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B, tokenize '你好！请自我介绍一下。' with return_tensors='pd', call model.generate(max_length=128) and print the decoded text. float32 may be used instead of float16 on CPU. The python in the environment configured by /work/env.sh must be able to run this script.
check: A Python script using the README API generates non-empty Chinese/text output from Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B for the README prompt.

revision.by: second review (outside the maintained set; independent log check of maintained passes)
issues: Too lenient: the oracle only checks the decoded text is >=10 bytes. Any non-empty decode (repeated punctuation, wrong-vocab garbage from a broken tokenizer or weight conversion) passes, although the README shows the expected Chinese self-introduction. v2 requires a Chinese answer (>=10 CJK characters, >=8 distinct characters, not an echo of the prompt).
Minor: the v1 oracle writes the Chinese text with open(...,'w') without an encoding; v2 pins utf-8.
Goal is fine: the float32-on-CPU note concerns the oracle's script, and installation hints (paddle version, aistudio-sdk breakage) are not leaked.
evidence: README_en.md:94-101 — Quick Start; expected output ['我是一个AI语言模型，我可以回答各种问题，...']
paddlenlp/generation/configuration_utils.py:131-140,198-201 — default decode strategy is greedy unless do_sample, so the output is deterministic and Chinese for this prompt
logs-paddlepaddle-paddlenlp oracle.txt — RESULT: [' 我是一个AI语言模型，我可以回答各种问题，包括但不限于：天气、新闻、历史、文化、科学、教育、娱乐等。请问您有什么需要了解的吗？'] (well above the v2 bar)
oracles/paddlepaddle-paddlenlp.sh — `[ "$(wc -c < $OUT/out.txt)" -ge 10 ]` is the only content check
